metadata.name: Mock Order Source
metadata.description: Deterministic fulfilment-hub/order_source implementer. Keeps orders in per-install D1, implements every op against that store, and fires source.order.created plus source.request.submitted from one mock_order_source_place_order call. The selling-system half of the hub shakedown fixture.

migrations.description: Orders, lines, fulfilment requests, locations and stock, plus the seed order a fresh install answers get_order with.

tools.name: mock_order_source_describe
tools.description: Report this adapter slug, its channel and its capability block. The hub reads capabilities to choose a path and never infers a limit from error text.

tools.name: mock_order_source_list_locations
tools.description: List the selling system locations a provider warehouse can be mapped onto.

tools.name: mock_order_source_register_location
tools.description: Create a selling system location for one provider warehouse, so stock and fulfilments can be attributed to it.

status.description: Async ack. accepted = done or in hand; error = a transient failure the hub may retry; rejected = terminal. The outcome, where there is one, arrives as a source.* event.

reason.description: Required when status is rejected or error.

tools.name: mock_order_source_get_order
tools.description: Read one order and its lines in the canonical shapes, by the selling system id. order_id comes back empty: the hub assigns it.

tools.name: mock_order_source_place_order
tools.description: Shakedown lever, not part of the interface. Creates one order with one line and one submitted fulfilment request, then emits source.order.created and source.request.submitted so the hub routes it. Ids are derived from source_number, so a script knows them in advance.

source_number.description: Human order number. Must be unique; the ids are derived from it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for the ship-to. Default AU.

emits.name: source.order.created
emits.description: A new order exists in the selling system, with its canonical order and lines. Fired by mock_order_source_place_order.

emits.name: source.order.updated
emits.description: An existing order changed. `changed` names the fields.

emits.name: source.order.cancelled
emits.description: The whole order was cancelled in the selling system.

emits.name: source.request.submitted
emits.description: THE routing trigger: a fulfilment request is ready to be routed to a warehouse. Fired by place_order and by the split half.

emits.name: source.request.cancellation_submitted
emits.description: The merchant asked to cancel a request the hub may already have pushed.

emits.name: source.request.hold_released
emits.description: A held request is routable again.

emits.name: source.stock.changed
emits.description: A sellable quantity changed in the selling system.
